stage.name: Take Me Home, Country Roads
stage.description:
Let's go. Let's all go home.
<Decorative Geyser> Units standing around it are unaffected by vapor, and will produce Pure White Steam when attacking.
<Steam Soda Bottle> When defeated, creates Pure White Steam in the surrounding area.
A large number of 'Fluffy Buddies' will appear on the field.

event.name: So Long, Adele: Home Away From Home - Retrospection

content.label: SL
content.name: So Long, Adele: Home Away From Home - Retrospection

urban_tornado_trendsetter.name: Urban 'Tornado Trendsetter'
urban_tornado_trendsetter.flavourText: A mass of fluffy critters fighting over cotton candy, and it's a little hard to tell where the fur ends and where the candyfloss begins. Instead of candyfloss they've only had a mouthful of sand, so now they're itching for a bite.
abilities: Explodes on first attack, dealing AoE Arts damage and spawning Carmine Steam
Summons a Hot Spring 'Jolly Rascal' and Fashion Street 'Robust Heavy' upon dying

hot_spring_jolly_rascal.name: Hot Spring 'Jolly Rascal'
hot_spring_jolly_rascal.flavourText: A fluffy critter that has found something nice on the street, and wants to play with whoever it bumps into. Even though you can't make out its expression from its obscured face, you can tell it's relishing in its delight—listen! It's laughing!
abilities: Leaves Carmine Steam at its location when defeated

fashion_street_hearty_heavy.name: Fashion Street 'Hearty Heavy'
fashion_street_hearty_heavy.flavourText: A fluffy critter that has found something nice from the sports field. It'll be really happy if you throw its 'treasure' back at it. Thankfully, it only throws frisbees, and not discuses.
abilities: Leaves Carmine Steam at its location when defeated

hot_spring_mischievous_rascal.name: Hot Spring 'Mischievous Rascal'
hot_spring_mischievous_rascal.flavourText: A fluffy critter that has found something nice on the street, and wants to play with whoever it bumps into. Even though you can't make out its expression from its obscured face, you can sense it in its revelry.
abilities: Leaves Carmine Steam at its location when defeated

hot_spring_wandering_slider.name: Hot Spring 'Wandering Slider'
hot_spring_wandering_slider.flavourText: A fluffy critter that has found something nice from the surfskate shop, so fast that it comes and goes without a trace! Not even the swirling mud or gravel can hinder its slick skating skills!
abilities: Can stack with a Hot Spring 'Jolly Rascal' and leaves Carmine Steam on tiles it travels over after combining

fluffy_buddy.name: 'Fluffy Buddy'
fluffy_buddy.flavourText: If these gentle and difficult-to-perceive fluffy critters suddenly appear in front of you, don't be frightened! In the hot springs, atop the white clouds, and in your memories... Will you still think of them years down the line?
abilities: Hidden in map, can be revealed by Carmine Steam or Pure White Steam
When in contact with Carmine Steam, its explosion produces more Carmine Steam on surrounding tiles and dealing Arts damage to nearby allied units
When in contact with Pure White Steam, its explosion produces more Pure White Steam on surrounding tiles and healing surrounding allied units

fashion_street_ordinary_aviator.name: Fashion Street 'Ordinary Aviator'
fashion_street_ordinary_aviator.flavourText: A fluffy critter that has found something nice from the aviation shop. It can fly, but it's not very good at it. Sometimes it can float up real high, but don't mistake it for a pink cloud!
abilities: Can stack with a Fashion Street 'Hearty Heavy' and is capable of long-range attacks after combining

fashion_street_hyperactive_aviator.name: Fashion Street 'Hyperactive Aviator'
fashion_street_hyperactive_aviator.flavourText: A fluffy critter that has found something nice from the aviation shop. It can fly, but it's not very good at it. However, it's learned to float around in a group, filling the sky with soft clouds and interrupting the people's leisurely sunbathing.
abilities: Can stack with a Fashion Street 'Robust Heavy' and is capable of long-range attacks after combining

big_man.name: 'Big Man'
big_man.flavourText: A humongous and somewhat slow-moving fluffy critter, its sturdiness possibly stems from never picking at its food. Some 'Little Fellas' will willingly be eaten, for this lets them ponder their thoughts—just what exactly is the difference between them and the volcano?
abilities: Throws a Hot Spring 'Jolly Rascal' on first attack

fashion_street_supernova_caster.name: Fashion Street 'Supernova Caster'
fashion_street_supernova_caster.flavourText: A fluffy critter that has found something nice from a mysterious divination shop that will make people who notice it 'see stars'! It has become even stronger due to the latest limited-edition magic hat on its head.
abilities: Attacks 3 units simultaneously when in contact with Carmine Steam
